1: #!/usr/bin/env node
2: // check-contrast.js — the gate that would have caught brilliant-on-grey.
3: //
4: // 2026-10-14: PN02 shipped brilliant-green (#00D639) icons on a light-grey
5: // (#F2F5F6) stripe at 1.8:1 — invisible to every existing gate (copy sync,
6: // bindings, sync-check, and verify-section all passed: the classes were
7: // right, the ASSET color was wrong). This gate pins icon-asset fills and
8: // text colors against the stripe background as WCAG ratios, in a real
9: // browser, from the same terms.json oracle the other tools use.
10: //
11: // WHAT IT CHECKS (per component `figma/terms.json` `theme` block):
12: //   icons: every fill painted by the section's SVG assets vs the computed
13: //     stripe background, min 3.0 (WCAG 1.4.11 non-text graphics)
14: //   texts: every listed selector's computed color vs background, min 4.5
15: //     (WCAG 1.4.3 normal text; alpha is blended over the bg first)
16: // A theme change (dark<->light) must move bg + icons + text together; any
17: // one left behind fails loudly here instead of shipping quietly.
18: //
19: // USAGE
20: //   node tooling/check-contrast.js --selftest
21: //   node tooling/check-contrast.js --comp pn02-highlights-6col --url http://127.0.0.1:8901/ongoing_project/cpp/customer-payment-services/
22: // Exit: 0 pass, 1 contrast FAIL, 2 operator error, 0 + loud SKIP without Chrome.
23: 'use strict';
24: const fs = require('fs');
25: const path = require('path');
26: 
27: const ROOT = path.join(__dirname, '..');
28: const argv = process.argv.slice(2);
29: const has = f => argv.includes(f);
30: const val = (f, d) => { const i = argv.indexOf(f); return i === -1 ? d : argv[i + 1]; };
31: 
32: // ------------------------------------------------------------- pure core ---
33: function parseColor(s) {
34:   s = String(s).trim().toLowerCase();
35:   const named = { white: [255, 255, 255, 1], black: [0, 0, 0, 1] };
36:   if (named[s]) return named[s];
37:   let m = s.match(/^#([0-9a-f]{6})$/);
38:   if (m) return [parseInt(m[1].slice(0, 2), 16), parseInt(m[1].slice(2, 4), 16), parseInt(m[1].slice(4, 6), 16), 1];
39:   m = s.match(/^#([0-9a-f]{3})$/);
40:   if (m) return [0, 1, 2].map(i => parseInt(m[1][i] + m[1][i], 16)).concat(1);
41:   m = s.match(/^rgba?\(\s*([\d.]+)\s*,\s*([\d.]+)\s*,\s*([\d.]+)(?:\s*,\s*([\d.]+))?\s*\)$/);
42:   if (m) return [+m[1], +m[2], +m[3], m[4] === undefined ? 1 : +m[4]];
43:   return null;
44: }
45: function luminance([r, g, b]) {
46:   const f = c => { c /= 255; return c <= 0.03928 ? c / 12.92 : Math.pow((c + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4); };
47:   return 0.2126 * f(r) + 0.7152 * f(g) + 0.0722 * f(b);
48: }
49: // fg may carry alpha: blend over opaque bg first (how the browser paints it).
50: function ratio(fgStr, bgStr) {
51:   const fg = parseColor(fgStr), bg = parseColor(bgStr);
52:   if (!fg || !bg) return null;
53:   const a = fg[3];
54:   const eff = [0, 1, 2].map(i => fg[i] * (1 - a) + bg[i] * a);
55:   const L1 = luminance(eff), L2 = luminance(bg.slice(0, 3));
56:   return (Math.max(L1, L2) + 0.05) / (Math.min(L1, L2) + 0.05);
57: }
58: // SVG asset fills: strip <defs> (clip paths paint nothing), collect fills.
59: function svgFills(text) {
60:   const noDefs = text.replace(/<defs[\s\S]*?<\/defs>/gi, '');
61:   const out = new Set();
62:   (noDefs.match(/fill\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"/gi) || []).forEach(m => {
63:     const c = m.split('"')[1].toLowerCase();
64:     if (c !== 'none') out.add(c);
65:   });
66:   (noDefs.match(/style\s*=\s*"[^"]*fill\s*:\s*([^;"]+)/gi) || []).forEach(m => {
67:     const c = m.split(':').pop().trim().toLowerCase();
68:     if (c !== 'none') out.add(c);
69:   });
70:   return [...out];
71: }
72: 
73: function selftest() {
74:   let pass = 0, fail = 0;
75:   const t = (n, cond, extra) => {
76:     if (cond) pass++;
77:     else { fail++; console.log(`  FAIL ${n}${extra === undefined ? '' : ' got ' + extra}`); }
78:   };
79:   console.log('WCAG math');
80:   t('black/white is 21', Math.abs(ratio('#000000', '#ffffff') - 21) < 0.01, ratio('#000000', '#ffffff'));
81:   const jade = ratio('#008146', '#F2F5F6');
82:   t('jade on light-grey passes text bar', jade >= 4.5 && jade < 4.7, jade);
83:   const bril = ratio('#00D639', '#F2F5F6');
84:   t('brilliant on light-grey fails graphics bar', bril !== null && bril < 3.0, bril);
85:   t('identical colors are 1', Math.abs(ratio('#F2F5F6', '#f2f5f6') - 1) < 0.001);
86:   const ink = ratio('rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)', 'rgb(242, 245, 246)');
87:   t('90%-black body text passes', ink !== null && ink >= 4.5, ink);
88:   t('bad color is null', ratio('nonsense', '#fff') === null);
89:   console.log('SVG fill extraction');
90:   const fills = svgFills('<svg fill="none"><defs><rect fill="white"/></defs><path fill="#008146"/><path fill="#008146"/></svg>');
91:   t('defs stripped, fills deduped', JSON.stringify(fills) === JSON.stringify(['#008146']), JSON.stringify(fills));
92:   console.log(`\n${pass} passed, ${fail} failed`);
93:   process.exit(fail ? 1 : 0);
94: }
95: 
96: // ------------------------------------------------------------------ I/O ---
97: async function run(comp, url, widths) {
98:   let puppeteer;
99:   try { puppeteer = require(path.join(ROOT, 'tooling', 'node_modules', 'puppeteer-core')); }
100:   catch { console.log('SKIP: puppeteer-core unavailable — contrast check NOT run (needs Chrome)'); process.exit(0); }
101:   const termsPath = path.join(ROOT, 'components', comp, 'figma', 'terms.json');
102:   if (!fs.existsSync(termsPath)) { console.error(`no terms.json for ${comp}`); process.exit(2); }
103:   const theme = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(termsPath, 'utf8')).theme;
104:   if (!theme) { console.error(`${comp}: terms.json has no theme block`); process.exit(2); }
105:   const exe = '/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome';
106:   if (!fs.existsSync(exe)) { console.log('SKIP: Chrome unavailable — contrast check NOT run'); process.exit(0); }
107: 
108:   let fails = 0;
109:   // icon assets: pure file I/O, width-independent (fail fast before Chrome)
110:   const iconColors = new Set();
111:   for (const f of (theme.icons || {}).files || []) {
112:     const fp = path.join(ROOT, theme.pageDir, f);
113:     if (!fs.existsSync(fp)) { console.log(`FAIL icon asset missing: ${f}`); fails++; continue; }
114:     svgFills(fs.readFileSync(fp, 'utf8')).forEach(c => iconColors.add(`${f}:${c}`));
115:   }
116:   if (!iconColors.size && fails === 0) { console.log('FAIL: no icon fills found'); fails++; }
117: 
118:   let browser;
119:   try {
120:     browser = await puppeteer.launch({ executablePath: exe, args: ['--no-sandbox', '--disable-gpu'] });
121:     const page = await browser.newPage();
122:     for (const w of widths) {
123:       await page.setViewport({ width: w, height: 900 });
124:       await page.goto(url, { waitUntil: 'networkidle0', timeout: 60000 });
125:       const got = await page.evaluate(sel => getComputedStyle(document.querySelector(sel)).backgroundColor, theme.bgSel).catch(() => null);
126:       if (got === null) { console.log(`FAIL ${w}: section ${theme.bgSel} missing`); fails++; continue; }
127:       console.log(`[${w}] bg ${theme.bgSel} = ${got}`);
128:       for (const ic of iconColors) {
129:         const [f, c] = ic.split(/:(?=#|\w)/);
130:         const r = ratio(c, got);
131:         const ok = r !== null && r >= (theme.icons.min || 3.0);
132:         console.log(`  ${ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'} icon ${f} ${c} vs bg = ${r === null ? 'unparseable' : r.toFixed(2)} (min ${(theme.icons.min || 3.0).toFixed(1)})`);
133:         if (!ok) fails++;
134:       }
135:       const texts = await page.evaluate(sel => {
136:         const out = {};
137:         const t = document.querySelector(sel + ' .hero-title-text-inner');
138:         const b = document.querySelector(sel + ' .score-highlight-body');
139:         if (t) out.title = getComputedStyle(t).color;
140:         if (b) { out.body = getComputedStyle(b).color; out.bodyWeight = getComputedStyle(b).fontWeight; }
141:         return out;
142:       }, theme.bgSel);
143:       for (const tx of theme.texts || []) {
144:         const key = tx.key;
145:         if (!texts[key]) { console.log(`  FAIL text ${key}: selector missing`); fails++; continue; }
146:         const r = ratio(texts[key], got);
147:         const ok = r !== null && r >= (tx.min || 4.5);
148:         console.log(`  ${ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'} text ${key} ${texts[key]} vs bg = ${r === null ? 'unparseable' : r.toFixed(2)} (min ${(tx.min || 4.5).toFixed(1)})`);
149:         if (!ok) fails++;
150:       }
151:       if (texts.bodyWeight) console.log(`  info body fontWeight = ${texts.bodyWeight}`);
152:     }
153:   } finally { if (browser) await browser.close(); }
154:   if (fails) { console.log(`${fails} contrast failure(s) (exit 1)`); process.exit(1); }
155:   console.log('CONTRAST CLEAN');
156:   process.exit(0);
157: }
158: 
159: if (has('--selftest')) selftest();
160: else {
161:   const comp = val('--comp', null), url = val('--url', null);
162:   if (!comp || !url) { console.error('usage: --comp <name> --url <http://…> [--widths 1920,390] | --selftest'); process.exit(2); }
163:   run(comp, url, val('--widths', '1920,390').split(',').map(Number)).catch(e => { console.error('ERROR ' + e.message.slice(0, 120)); process.exit(2); });
164: }

part.text:
Done. Summary:

**Root cause**: The alpha blending formula in `ratio()` was inverted. Line 54 blended background into foreground (`fg[i] * (1 - a) + bg[i] * a`) instead of foreground into background. For opaque backgrounds, this swapped the roles: `(1-a)` went to fg and `a` went to bg.

**Fix**: Changed to `fg[i] * a + bg[i] * (1 - a)` so proper foreground alpha is applied.

**Regression guard test added**: `ratio('rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)', 'rgb(255, 255, 255)')` — under the broken formula this returned ~6.9 (way too high), now correctly returns ~1.8.
